top_choice_rationale: P001 honours an original idea (the magic-wavelength lattice, Katori) with a first realization and a verified record: independent laboratories have reached and intercompared 1e-18 uncertainty. It is distinct from the 2005 comb and 2012 single-ion prizes, the two-name allocation (Katori, Ye) is the cleanest on the slate and was named by every member, and the citation is scoped to the lattice so it does not claim the whole clock family. P002 is a real discovery with a secure flat-band prediction, but Yuan Cao is left outside the three names and the mechanism and timing are less settled, so I rank it second ahead of no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile for P001 or P002; the electron-optics ballot B013 lies in my own field but is not in this slate
